zh.title: 阿聯酋航空收購退役空中巴士A380拆解零件
zh.summary: 阿聯酋航空收購退役A380進行拆解；內部零件價值高於整架客機。
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 於二〇二六年八月的報導，阿聯酋航空正在購買已退役的空中巴士 A380 客機。該航空公司採購這些退役客機的主要目的並非將其投入飛航營運，而是計畫將機體進行拆解作業。
報導分析指，此類退役空中巴士 A380 機體內部的零部件與組件總價值，實際上已經高於整架完整客機本身的市場價值。此狀況使得拆解該款客機成為對阿聯酋航空更具效益的處置方式。
這意味著對於阿聯酋航空而言，取得已退役的 A380 機身並進行拆解以獲取內部零件，相較於維持整架客機運作具有不同的價值評估。

en.title: Emirates Buys Retired Airbus A380s for Parts Reclamation
en.summary: Emirates purchases retired Airbus A380 aircraft to dismantle them for valuable spare parts.
body: Emirates is acquiring retired Airbus A380 aircraft for dismantling purposes rather than for operational passenger service, according to reporting by Simple Flying in August 2026. The airline is purchasing these retired superjumbos specifically to disassemble them and extract their component parts.

The decision is driven by market valuation, as the individual components and parts housed within a retired Airbus A380 are currently worth more than the intact aircraft itself. Consequently, acquiring the aircraft for parts reclamation provides a higher overall financial return for Emirates than attempting to operate or retain the full airplane.

sources.name: Simple Flying — Why Retired Airbus A380s Are Now Worth More Dead Than Alive…

facts.claim: Emirates is buying retired Airbus A380 aircraft to take them apart rather than fly them.
facts.sourceQuote: Emirates is buying retired A380s not to fly them but to take them apart.

facts.claim: The component parts inside a retired Airbus A380 are worth more than the intact aircraft itself.
